issues.description: The exercise requires implementing getters for each attribute (public getters as implied by the task/test names), but in the solution two getters are declared private: getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents(). This visibility mismatch conflicts with the specification/tests that expect public access and will confuse students or cause tests to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the getters public to match the task description and expected tests. Specifically, change getLectureName() and getNumberOfInscribedStudents() to public in the solution (and ensure the template guidance indicates public getters), so all attribute getters are publicly accessible as required by the exercise.
